expected_diagnosis: Reinstall is destructive and no recent backup visible.
recommended_next_checks: Verify desired OS, service ID, data retention and backup.
resolution_guidance: Do not reinstall before informed approval and backup plan.
verification: After authorized reinstall verify OS, access and network.
escalate_when: Unclear data backup, ownership or reinstatement policy.
production_warning: Không áp dụng lệnh chỉnh sửa trên VPS khách hàng khi chưa có quyền, backup và kế hoạch rollback.
